headline: Calls For Impeachment And Resignation Of Gibran Rakabuming Raka Grow
seoTitle: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Faces Impeachment Demands
metaDescription: Student groups and political representatives are calling for the resignation or impeachment of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka at the DPR.
aiSummaryBullets: Student protesters demonstrated at the DPR building demanding the impeachment of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Members of the PKS party have publicly advocated for the Vice President's resignation or a formal legislative review process.
The DPR has officially acknowledged the public petitions and protests calling for action against the Vice President.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian House of Representatives (DPR) held its 11th Plenary Meeting for the 2026-2027 session, which served as a focal point for public and political pressure regarding the Vice President, Gibran Rakabuming Raka. Following the plenary session, various groups and individuals, including representatives from the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS), displayed posters and banners demanding that the Vice President either step down voluntarily or face formal impeachment proceedings. Student organizations also gathered outside the parliamentary complex in Jakarta to express these demands through speeches and protests. The DPR Bureau of Cooperation and Aspirations (BAM) confirmed that the institution has received these public expressions and acknowledged the push for a formal review of the Vice President's position. While political figures have stated that voluntary resignation would be preferable, they also suggested that the established legislative mechanisms within the DPR are prepared to address the calls for removal.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant traction across multiple news outlets with a high velocity of coverage, reflecting intense political activity within the parliamentary complex.
